articles.title: Sales automation startup Rox AI hits $1.2B valuation, sources say
articles.summary: Rox, founded in 2024 by the former chief growth officer of New Relic, offers an AI-native alternative to CRM tools.

articles.title: Facebook Marketplace now lets Meta AI respond to buyers’ messages
articles.summary: When buyers inquire about an item’s availability, sellers can use Meta AI to automatically draft replies using information from their listing, such as the description, availability, pickup location, and price.

articles.title: Tinder tries to lure people back to online dating with IRL events, virtual speed dating
articles.summary: Tinder just got a major revamp as it attempts to reengage its user base and attract younger daters. This includes in-person events, AI enhancements, and even virtual speed dating.

articles.title: Atlassian follows Block’s footsteps and cuts staff in the name of AI
articles.summary: Atlassian laid off 10% of its workforce, around 1,600 people, as the company looks to funnel more funds to AI.

articles.title: Bumble to launch an AI dating assistant, ‘Bee’
articles.summary: Bumble's new AI assistant Bee will move the dating app beyond the swipe by matching people based on compatibility and goals.

articles.title: A writer is suing Grammarly for turning her and other authors into ‘AI editors’ without consent
articles.summary: Journalist Julia Angwin is leading a class action lawsuit against Grammarly for violating her privacy and publicity rights.

articles.title: Gumloop lands $50M from Benchmark to turn every employee into an AI agent builder
articles.summary: As companies race to adopt AI, Benchmark general partner Everett Randle believes the key to success lies in empowering every worker with AI superpowers, and Gumloop’s intuitive agent builder is an example of the kind of tool that will unlock that potential.

articles.title: Alexa+ gets a new ‘adults only’ personality option that curses but won’t get into NSFW content
articles.summary: The new Sassy style can curse and roast you, but the fun ends there.

articles.title: Wonderful raises $150M Series B at $2B valuation
articles.summary: The funding round, led by Insight Partners, comes just four months after Wonderful raised a $100 million Series A.

articles.title: Google is using old news reports and AI to predict flash floods
articles.summary: A new way to solve data scarcity: Turning qualitative reports into quantitative data with an LLM.

articles.title: Google Maps is getting an AI ‘Ask Maps’ feature and upgraded ‘immersive’ navigation
articles.summary: The tech giant says the "Immersive Navigation" launch is the biggest update to Maps in over a decade.

articles.title: AI ‘actor’ Tilly Norwood put out the worst song I’ve ever heard
articles.summary: This song is an AI actor's rallying cry to other AI actors, urging them to keep going despite the naysayers who doubt their humanity. Literally no one can relate to this.

articles.title: Ford’s new AI assistant will help fleet owners know if seatbelts are being used
articles.summary: Ford Pro AI debuted at Work Truck Week in Indianapolis and is now available to all of its U.S.-based Pro telematics subscribers.

articles.title: Zendesk acquires agentic customer service startup Forethought
articles.summary: Forethought was years ahead of its time and the 2018 winner of TechCrunch Battlefield.

articles.title: Netflix may have paid $600 million for Ben Affleck’s AI startup
articles.summary: This deal could rank as among the streaming giant's largest acquisitions ever.

articles.title: Lovable says it added $100M in revenue last month alone, with just 146 employees
articles.summary: Swedish vibe-coding unicorn Lovable crossed $400 million in annual recurring revenue (ARR) in February.

articles.title: Replit snags $9B valuation 6 months after hitting $3B
articles.summary: Replit raised a new $400 million round and said it hopes to have $1B in ARR by year's end.

articles.title: WordPress debuts a private workspace that runs in your browser via a new service, my.WordPress.net
articles.summary: WordPress’s new browser-based service lets users create private sites without hosting or signing up, turning the platform into a personal workspace for writing, research, and AI tools.

articles.title: Rivian spin-out Mind Robotics raises $500M for industrial AI-powered robots
articles.summary: The startup, which was created by Rivian founder RJ Scaringe, is looking to train on data from, and deploy in, Rivian's factory.

articles.title: Meta’s Moltbook deal points to a future built around AI agents
articles.summary: Meta’s Moltbook acquisition may look odd at first, but the deal could signal how Meta sees AI agents shaping future advertising and commerce on an agentic web.

articles.summary: Residents want to put tax breaks to a vote

articles.summary: Brings overall future leases for hyperscalers to more than $700bn

articles.title: Viavi launches AI-driven fiber monitoring unit to prevent damage to networks & pipelines
articles.summary: FTH-DAS combines embedded machine learning with distributed acoustic sensing for autonomous Edge protection

articles.summary: The fiber provider has paired with Affinity Water and Lightsonic on the pilot

articles.summary: Could lease hundreds of megawatts of capacity

articles.title: Surf Internet closes $407m fiber asset-backed securitization
articles.summary: Will finance Surf's plans to ride the waves of Great Lakes network expansion

articles.title: Virginia legislature passes balcony solar bill
articles.summary: The bill allows Virginia residents to plug in a “small portable solar generation device” with a maximum power output of 1,200 watts.

articles.title: PJM is now using ambient-adjusted transmission ratings. Other grid operators will soon follow.
articles.summary: While other grid operators are set to follow suit this year, the Midcontinent and New York grid operators don't plan to adopt the more precise line ratings until 2028.

articles.title: America’s power shortage is a market failure
articles.summary: Early buildout of the U.S. rail system was fragmented, with local projects often failing to connect regions. Grid developers today should pay heed, writes Maria Martinez of the Clean Economy Project.

articles.title: New York needs more time to meet climate goals, Gov. Hochul says
articles.summary: “We just need some breathing room,” said Gov. Kathy Hochul, noting high cost estimates for compliance with the 2030 goal. “My job is dealing in reality. This is the reality I have.”

articles.title: Germany’s RWE plans nearly $20B US investment, including gas peakers
articles.summary: RWE had put U.S. investment decisions on hold, in part due to tariff uncertainty, but officials credit the One Big Beautiful Bill Act last year with jump-starting its plans to build fossil plants.

articles.title: EPB of Chattanooga deploys battery-based microgrids for savings, resilience
articles.summary: Within three years, the Tennessee distribution utility could have as much as 150 MW of energy storage on its system, representing more than 10% of peak load, an executive told Utility Dive.

articles.title: US entities face heightened cyber risk related to Iran war
articles.summary: The military campaign against Iran is putting local governments, critical infrastructure providers and major U.S. companies at heightened risk of disruptive attacks.

articles.title: 4 affordability solutions states and utilities can implement now
articles.summary: States can take steps to drive electricity cost savings more quickly as well as pursue long-term reform, write Allison Clements, a former member of the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, and Lori Bird of the WRI Polsky Energy Center.

articles.title: FERC approves ComEd data center transmission agreements
articles.summary: FERC Chairman Swett and Commissioner LaCerte pushed back on concerns over inadequate review of ratepayer impacts: “The Commission will always reject a rate that seriously harms the consuming public.”

articles.title: Long-duration energy storage deployments rose 49% in 2025: WoodMac
articles.summary: Falling prices and robust supply chains mean lithium-ion batteries are becoming more competitive at longer durations than emerging technologies, it said.

articles.title: Lithuania assessing potential for BWRX-300 deployment
articles.summary: Poland's SGE, Ignalina Nuclear Power Plant operator Altra and GE Vernova Hitachi Nuclear Energy have signed a memorandum of understanding to assess the potential for BWRX-300 small modular reactors in Lithuania.

articles.title: 'Transformative' research reactor mooted for Texas A&M
articles.summary: The Texas A&M Engineering Experiment Station has signed an agreement with advanced small modular reactor company ZettaJoule to explore building a very-high temperature modular reactor that could attract USD1 billion in research funding.

articles.title: Potential sites identified for SMRs in Chernobyl exclusion zone
articles.summary: The State Agency of Ukraine for Exclusion Zone Management has said that sites by two long-abandoned villages have been identified as potential locations for future small modular reactors.

articles.title: Amazon and Meta agreements boost Vistra nuclear plants
articles.summary: Landmark power purchase agreements with companies including Amazon Web Services and Meta are supporting Vistra Corp's plans to relicense and uprate its nuclear plants - but the focus on uprates is likely to come after 2028, the company's CEO has said.

articles.title: IAEA: Nuclear diplomacy is hard, but never impossible
articles.summary: The International Atomic Energy Agency has urged restraint following the military attacks in Iran and the Middle East, and said it is ready to play its part in finding a diplomatic solution.

articles.title: Largest module installed at second Lufeng unit
articles.summary: The CA20 module - measuring about 20 metres in length, 14 metres in width and with a height of 21 metres - has been hoisted into place at the second unit of the Lufeng nuclear power plant in Guangdong province.

articles.title: SRS to construct Romanian reactor research facilities
articles.summary: Newcleo subsidiary SRS Servizi di Ricerche e Sviluppo has been contracted by Romanian state-owned nuclear R&D coordination organisation RATEN to supply lead-cooled nuclear reactor research facilities.

articles.title: First concrete poured for new capacity at Kaiga in India
articles.summary: The first pouring of concrete marks the point at which a project becomes a nuclear power unit under construction - the aim is for the first new unit at the Kaiga nuclear power plant to achieve criticality in five years.

articles.title: Cameco and India sign new uranium supply agreement
articles.summary: Canada's Cameco has entered a long-term agreement to supply uranium ore concentrate to India's Department of Atomic Energy, for use in the country's fleet of nuclear reactors.

articles.title: Safety work planned for Chernobyl turbine hall
articles.summary: A contract has been signed for the development of detailed design documentation for work on parts of the turbine hall and deaerator stack that extend beyond the giant New Safe Confinement arch-shaped shelter which encloses the ruins of Chernobyl’s unit 4.

articles.title: KHNP, EMA to cooperate on Singapore SMR study
articles.summary: Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power has signed a memorandum of understanding with Singapore's Energy Market Authority to cooperate on civil nuclear energy, particularly small modular reactors.

articles.title: Fisher German lands Wylfa advisory contract
articles.summary: UK land and property consultancy Fisher German has secured a contract to provide Great British Energy - Nuclear with expert advice during the planning and delivery of its small modular reactor project at Wylfa on the island of Anglesey, North Wales.

articles.title: Potential for CANDU units in Turkey to be explored
articles.summary: Candu Energy and Türkiye Nuclear Energy Company have signed a memorandum of understanding to assess the potential for the deployment of Canadian CANDU reactor technology as Turkey looks to expand its nuclear energy capacity.

articles.title: South Korea to cooperate with the Philippines on nuclear power projects
articles.summary: Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power, the Export-Import Bank of Korea and the Philippines' largest private electric distribution utility Manila Electric Company have signed a tripartite memorandum of understanding for cooperation in developing nuclear power plants in the Philippines.

articles.title: Aalo secures fuel and turbine for experimental reactor
articles.summary: Aalo Atomics, a US developer of sodium-cooled small modular reactors for data centres, has signed a fuel fabrication contract with Global Nuclear Fuel. Meanwhile, Baker Hughes has been contracted to supply the steam turbine for Aalo-X, Aalo's experimental reactor.

articles.title: The mouse-sized robot developed to inspect the Large Hadron Collider
articles.summary: A 3.7 centimetre-wide robot has been designed to travel along the 27-kilometre Large Hadron Collider to allow remote inspections of the world’s most powerful particle accelerator.

articles.title: Standard design approval sought for i-SMR
articles.summary: South Korea's Nuclear Safety and Security Commission has received an application for standard design approval for the Innovative Small Modular Reactor from the i-SMR Technology Development Project Group.

articles.title: NRC issues construction permit for first Natrium plant
articles.summary: The US Nuclear Regulatory Commission has approved a construction permit for TerraPower's Kemmerer unit 1 project - the first such permit for a commercial-scale non-light water reactor in the country for four decades.

articles.title: Contracts awarded for Dukovany control system modernisation
articles.summary: The work includes replacement of the unit control systems of the primary and secondary circuits on all four generating units at the Dukovany nuclear power plant in the Czech Republic.

articles.title: EC needs strategy in efforts to improve global nuclear safety, say auditors
articles.summary: The effectiveness of the European Commission's support for non-EU countries in enhancing their nuclear safety is hampered by the lack of a comprehensive and up-to-date strategy and shortcomings in the monitoring of the financed actions, according to the European Court of Auditors.
